summary: Vivmark Residential (formerly Equity Residential) filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its acquisition of AvalonBay Communities via a merger into Canopy Merger Sub LLC, a subsidiary, followed by a subsequent merger into ERP Operating Limited Partnership. The transaction, under an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated May 20, 2026, closed on August 17, 2026. The filing executes supplemental indentures for assumed debt, but no per-share price, premium, or advisor details are disclosed. This is a completed acquisition; watch for post-merger integration and debt servicing under the amended indentures.
